# o11y_alert_notification_template (Resource)

A revisioned reusable Email and Slack notification template. Publishing is explicit and policies bind immutable published revisions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "o11y_alert_notification_template" "customer_impact" {
  template_key  = "customer-impact"
  name          = "Customer impact"
  description   = "Rich Email and Slack notification for customer-impacting incidents."
  change_reason = "Manage the customer-impact template in Terraform"
  published     = true

  document_json = jsonencode({
    schema_version   = 1
    subject_template = "[{{ incident.severity }}] {{ incident.title }}"
    firing = {
      title_template   = "{{ incident.title }}"
      summary_template = "{{ incident.customer_impact }}"
      blocks = [
        {
          key      = "summary"
          markdown = { text_template = "*Customer impact*\n{{ incident.customer_impact }}\n\n*Why this fired*\n{{ hypothesis }}" }
        },
        {
          key = "signal"
          fields = {
            title_template = "Signal"
            fields = [
              { label_template = "Severity", value_path = "incident.severity", format = "NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_VALUE_FORMAT_V1_TEXT" },
              { label_template = "Confidence", value_path = "impact.confidence", format = "NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_VALUE_FORMAT_V1_PERCENT" },
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          key = "actions"
          actions = {
            actions = [
              {
                label_template = "Open alert"
                link           = "NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_ACTION_LINK_V1_OPEN_ALERT"
                style          = "NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_ACTION_STYLE_V1_PRIMARY"
              },
              {
                label_template = "View traces"
                link           = "NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_ACTION_LINK_V1_VIEW_TRACES"
                style          = "NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_ACTION_STYLE_V1_DEFAULT"
              },
            ]
          }
        },
      ]
    }
    resolved = {
      title_template   = "Resolved: {{ incident.title }}"
      summary_template = "Customer impact has recovered."
      blocks = [{
        key      = "recovery"
        markdown = { text_template = "*Resolved*\nCustomer impact has recovered." }
      }]
    }
    reminder = {
      title_template   = "Reminder: {{ incident.title }}"
      summary_template = "Customer impact is still ongoing."
      blocks = [{
        key      = "ongoing-impact"
        markdown = { text_template = "*Ongoing customer impact*\n{{ incident.customer_impact }}" }
      }]
    }
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `change_reason` (String) Audited reason for the desired revision or lifecycle change.
- `document_json` (String) Typed NotificationTemplateDocumentV1 protobuf JSON. Unknown variables or block shapes fail closed.
- `name` (String)
- `template_key` (String) Stable immutable user-template key.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `provenance_ref` (String) Optional source repository, module, or control-plane reference.
- `published` (Boolean) Publish the current revision. Publishing never silently changes existing policy bindings.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `current_revision_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `published_revision_id` (String) Immutable revision currently available for new policy bindings.
- `revision` (Number) Monotonic optimistic-concurrency revision.
- `updated_at` (String)

## JSON attributes

Write `document_json` with `jsonencode()`. The provider decodes it as protobuf JSON and refuses an unknown field at plan time.

- Use the snake_case field names below. The camelCase protobuf JSON names also work, but import and drift write snake_case.
- Write enum values as the full names listed.
- "Required" means the server refuses the document without the field. For a template string, that includes an empty or blank one.

### document_json

`NotificationTemplateDocumentV1`. One Email and Slack message layout for each lifecycle event, at most 128 KiB.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | uint32 | Required | Must be `1`. |
| `subject_template` | string | Required | Email subject, one line. |
| `firing` | object | Required | Variant for a firing alert, described below. |
| `resolved` | object | Required | Variant for a resolved alert. |
| `reminder` | object | Required | Variant for a repeat reminder. |
| `default_locale` | string | Optional | BCP-47 locale of the top-level variants, for example `en-US`. Defaults to `en-US`. |
| `localizations` | list(object) | Optional | Up to 20 translated sets, described below. |

Template strings interpolate variables with `{{ path }}`, and MiniJinja filters and expressions work inside them. Control statements (`{%`) and comments (`{#`) are refused, and each template string is at most 8 KiB. The server only checks the syntax of an interpolated name when the template is saved; a name the notification does not carry fails when it renders. Use the variables below. String values are Markdown-escaped before they are interpolated.

A variant, `NotificationTemplateVariantV1`:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title_template` | string | Required | Message title, one line. |
| `summary_template` | string | Required | One-line summary. |
| `blocks` | list(object) | Required | 1 to 32 blocks, rendered in order. |

A block, `NotificationTemplateBlockV1`, has a `key` and exactly one content field:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | string | Required | Unique within the variant. ASCII letters, digits, `_`, and `-`, at most 80 bytes. |
| `visible_when` | object | Optional | `{ path, equals }`: the block renders only when the variable at `path` equals the string `equals`, at most 256 bytes. `path` is a variable from the list below, and a path the notification does not carry fails the render. The comparison uses the Markdown-escaped value: `_`, `*`, backtick, backslash, `&`, `<`, and `>` are escaped. To match `slo_burn`, the value must be `slo\_burn`, which is `equals = "slo\\_burn"` in HCL. Numbers and booleans compare as text, and `null` matches `"null"`. |
| `markdown` | object | One content field | `{ text_template }`. Multi-line Markdown. |
| `fields` | object | One content field | `{ title_template, fields }`, with 1 to 12 fields, each `{ label_template, value_path, format }`. |
| `progress` | object | One content field | `{ label_template, value_path }`. The value must be a number; it is clamped to 0 to 1. |
| `chart` | object | One content field | `{ chart_key, title_template }`. Any key of ASCII letters, digits, `_`, and `-` is accepted, but only `bad_eval_rate`, `cost_per_success`, `burn_rate`, `latency_error`, and `tool_failure_spike` render, and only when the alert provides that chart. Otherwise the block is left out. |
| `evidence` | object | One content field | `{ title_template, max_items }`, with 1 to 20 items. Left out when the alert has no evidence. |
| `code` | object | One content field | `{ title_template, value_path, max_characters }`, with 1 to 8,000 characters. Renders the value as compact JSON, cut to `max_characters` with `...`. |
| `actions` | object | One content field | `{ actions }`, with 1 to 5 buttons, each `{ label_template, link, style }`. A button whose link the notification lacks is left out, and so is the block when none remain. |
| `footer` | object | One content field | `{ text_template }`. Multi-line. |

Every `*_template` field inside a block is required. Labels, and the titles of `chart`, `evidence`, and `code` blocks, must be one line.

Enum values:

- `format`: `NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_VALUE_FORMAT_V1_` plus `TEXT`, `NUMBER`, `PERCENT`, `CURRENCY_USD`, `DURATION_MS`, `TIMESTAMP`, or `JSON`. Required.
- `link`: `NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_ACTION_LINK_V1_` plus `OPEN_ALERT`, `VIEW_TRACES`, `VIEW_EVALS`, `SILENCE`, `ACKNOWLEDGE`, `OPEN_INVESTIGATION`, `VIEW_LOGS`, `VIEW_METRICS`, `VIEW_SLO`, or `OPEN_RUNBOOK`. Required.
- `style`: `NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE_ACTION_STYLE_V1_` plus `DEFAULT`, `PRIMARY`, or `DANGER`. Required.

A localization, `NotificationTemplateLocalizationV1`, has a `locale`, a `subject_template`, and its own `firing`, `resolved`, and `reminder` variants, all required. Each `locale` is unique and differs from `default_locale`. A recipient's locale picks the exact match, then the language, then the top-level variants.

Variables, for `{{ path }}`, `value_path`, and `visible_when.path`:

| Path | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event.type` | string | Lifecycle event, for example `firing`. |

| `links.open_investigation_url` | url | Investigation link. |

## Behaviour notes

- `template_key` is stored in lowercase and cannot change. Write it in lowercase: an uppercase key comes back lowercased, which fails the apply.
- The server trims `name` (at most 256 bytes) and `description` (at most 2,000 bytes). Leading or trailing whitespace comes back removed, which fails the apply.
- A policy binds an exact published revision. Publishing a new revision never changes a policy that already bound an older one.
- A published revision cannot be unpublished. Change `document_json` to start a new draft, or keep `published = true`.

## Import

```shell
terraform import o11y_alert_notification_template.example <template id>
```

After import `document_json` holds the provider's canonical form: snake_case names and full enum names. Match that form, or copy the value from `terraform state show`, to avoid an in-place update that creates a new revision.
